publisher: City of Cortez GIS (hosted on Montezuma County GIS server)
notes: City of Cortez zoning districts, stored on the city parcel layer as ZONE_Cortez (codes such as R1, R2, R3, CBD, NB, C, I, PUD, RE, O). Filtered to parcels with a city zone code. Parcel-based polygons; the city zone code is the district. The county layer MontezumaPlanningMap/72 carries the same values in ZONE_Cortez but its ZONE_ field reads City for them.
